text:
alex: Quick thread — proposing an on-call SOP change for rewrap operations on BYOK HSM keys during incident windows. TL;DR: allow SRE to run temporary rewrap with two-person approval, immutable audit artifact, and strict RBAC. Thoughts?

maria: quick q — why do we need this instead of the vendor rewrap flow?

alex: vendor rewrap is fine normally but in recent incident we were blocked 4h waiting for vendor ops; customer SLOs hit. Proposal: emergency rewrap path used only when vendor unreachable and impact >SLO threshold.

sam: immediately a compliance flag — emergency operator rewrap could change PCI/CCPA scope. need legal + compliance signoff and clear customer contract language.

jordan: can we implement fallback through the KMS sidecar so the KEK never leaves HSM boundary? e.g., ephemeral HSM-to-HSM rewrap: no plaintext KEK on host.

liam: rough outline: ephemeral unwrap inside HSM A -> rewrap to HSM B slot -> produce signed metadata. Pseudocode for infra doc:
```bash
# run inside secure bastion, no disk writes
kmstool unwrap --hsm-slot=A --key-id=cust-KEK --attest=on
kmstool wrap   --hsm-slot=B --policy=customer-bound --out=metadata.json
sha256sum metadata.json > metadata.sha256
```

olivia: from compliance: any operator action needs 2-person auth + video capture + retention in immutable store. Also contract review: emergency key actuation must be permitted in the customer's SLA or we require explicit opt-in. I'll draft language.

alex: plan also includes automated audit write: `s3://immutable-audit/byok/rewrap/1773334444/` with metadata, command stdout hashed, and operator PD ack id.

compliance-bot: Reminder: policy BYOK-6 -> "Emergency actuation requires documented customer opt-in OR court/ops exception". Check account flag `byok_emergency_optin=true`.

maria: technical RBAC idea: create time-limited role `rewrap-emergency` provisioned via JIT workflow. Role includes `expires_at`, `justification`, `pd_incident_id` claims, and is scoped to specific key prefixes.

sam: +1 for JIT. For logs: add `event_type=rewrap_attempt` with fields `operator`, `approver`, `pd_ack`, `video_url`, `metadata_sha256` forwarded to SIEM. Set high-fidelity retention for these events.

jordan: vuln triage note — any automation must avoid writing KEK into host memory or swap. Enforce mlock on helper process and audit memory maps after run. Add this to code-review checklist.

liam: incident playbook snippet proposal:
1) T0: detect vendor unavailability
2) T+30m: escalate to vendor + open PD incident
3) T+2h: if vendor unreachable and customer impact >SLO -> request legal signoff + security approval via PD ack
4) on approvals: provision `rewrap-emergency` JIT role for operator A and approver B, run rewrap in bastion, capture video + upload to immutable bucket, publish SIEM event
5) post-incident: rotate/rewrap back to customer-managed KEK and run audit sweep

olivia: I'll draft contract addendum for "emergency actuation" and list acceptable evidence artifacts. Also will add retention policy for the video + audit (suggest 7 years for enterprise regs).

alex: thanks — I'll open infra PR for JIT RBAC TTL and runbook change, add SIEM webhook. tagging @maria @sam for review. :thumbsup:

maria: will review PR tomorrow — leave comments on 2FA & video storage encryption.

sam: also include a test drill checklist so we exercise the emergency path quarterly. avoids surprises during real incident.

jordan: one more: include a post-mortem template that captures customer notification timeline and rewrap justification.

alex: great, I'll assemble PR + runbook + compliance draft. moving to #release-war-room for coordination when we test.

[deploy-bot]: Scheduled: created doc `infra/rewrap-emergency-role` (link: https://git.internal/r/infra/rewrap-emergency-role)

alex: thanks all. closing thread for now — will ping once PR is up. :white_check_mark:
